'''Sinta Glacier''' was a massive chunk of [[Water|ice]], billions of [[Standard year|years]] old, which had once been the core of a [[Comet|mega-comet]], and was eventually caught in the [[orbit]] of the [[star]] [[Sinta]]. The [[Sinta Glacier Colony]] was a settlement on the glacier which extracted ice cores that contained traces of [[malsarr]].<ref name="TROS VD" />
